responsibility: Implements GCC’s core tree/GIMPLE control-flow graph construction and mutation machinery. It builds basic blocks and edges from GIMPLE sequences, creates and redirects branch, switch, goto, asm, EH, and OpenMP-related edges, maintains label-to-block and case-label mappings, updates discriminators and profiling-sensitive CFG state, supports block/edge splitting, duplication, verification, and dumping, and provides the central CFG semantics that other tree passes rely on when restructuring functions.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete implementation of the tree/GIMPLE CFG API declared in gcc/tree-cfg.h, including block/edge construction, redirection, verification, dumping, and CFG selftests; the header is the shared declaration surface used by other passes.
